newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Natsteel Broadway sees slower profit gain.
newsitem.headline: Natsteel Broadway sees slower profit gain.

text.p: NatSteel Broadway said on Thursday profits were unlikely to grow in 1997 at the rate of 1996.

It said in a statement on results for the year ended December 31, 1996, that: "the directors expect the group to achieve satisfactory growth in 1997, although the rate of profit growth is not expected to match that of 1996."

China-based NatSteel Broadway, an integrated contract manufacturer of plastic and metal components for electronics products, reported a 33.1 percent gain in net profit in 1996 to Singapore $13.1 million. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
